mapper.sql: NID, NodeName, Url, ParentNode, Orders, NodeExplain
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nodes ORDER BY Orders ASC, NID ASC
SELECT n.NID, n.NodeName, n.Url, n.ParentNode, n.Orders, n.NodeExplain FROM nodes n INNER JOIN rolenodes rn ON n.NID = rn.NID WHERE rn.RID = #{rid} ORDER BY n.Orders ASC, n.NID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nodes (NodeName, Url, ParentNode, Orders, NodeExplain) VALUES (#{nodeName}, #{url}, #{parentNode}, #{orders}, #{nodeExplain})
